name: cursor-onboarding-platform
status: SKELETON — not published, not loaded, no runtime behavior. Documents the intended platform-core vs library-pack split so extraction is a lift-and-shift, not a rewrite.
description: Portable Cursor onboarding platform (persona SDLC rails) plus a swappable per-library content pack. This fork ships the MONAI pack in-repo for a reliable v1 walkthrough; the manifest below is the extraction contract.
why_skeleton: Publishing this folder as-is would be wrong for other libraries (the pack is MONAI-specific: intensity transforms + Phase 1 loss/metric/network packs). We keep the pack in-repo for v1 and record the split here so the walkthrough stays reliable while showing the productization path.

seam.summary: How core and pack compose in Cursor. Split by READER, because Cursor has no cross-plugin path resolution: a hook in platform-core cannot read a file inside pack-monai.
seam.design: Design 1 (chosen): one shared boundary engine in platform-core; packs are content + a per-consumer config instance. Scales to N libraries with the engine written once. Design 2 (rejected): each pack ships self-contained boundary hooks — more purely Cursor-native but duplicates the engine per library.
seam.agent_facing_content: Pack RULES and /scaffold-* skills are INJECTED by Cursor into agent context when the pack is enabled — no path resolution by us. Library specifics reach core skill shells via these injected rules, NOT a cross-plugin body splice.
seam.refs: refs/ is NOT a Cursor injection surface (Cursor injects rules/skills/agents/hooks/commands/mcp). Pattern: authoring SSOT in plugins/pack-monai/refs/, MATERIALIZED into the consumer's .cursor/refs/ (by /init-pack, same .env.example->.env pattern as pack.config.json). Rules cite the workspace path .cursor/refs/<file>.md; the agent opens it on demand with its file tool — no injection, no cross-plugin resolution, no context bloat. Keeps rules concise + always-on and refs deep + on-demand. Do NOT inline whole refs into rules, do NOT leave refs as consumer SSOT, and do NOT point the agent at @pack-monai/refs/... . Drift between SSOT and copy is guarded by sync-check.
seam.hook_facing_config: Allowlists / coach patterns / nudge globs / sync inventory live in the consumer's single .cursor/pack.config.json, read by hooks at $CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR/.cursor/pack.config.json (the documented, working path). The pack owns pack.config.schema.json + a filled example; the consumer commits an instance (.env.example -> .env pattern).
seam.no_plugin_pointer: There is NO 'plugin:pack-monai/...' pointer and NO thin .cursor/pack.json. The consumer's pack.config.json carries a top-level 'pack' field for identity.
seam.pack_loading: Cursor HAS a loader: the workspaceOpen hook can return pluginPaths. v1 uses manual enable of both plugins (core = Required, pack = Default Off); workspaceOpen auto-load (reads the 'pack' field) is a post-spike upgrade.
seam.missing_config: everyday: warn + safe empty defaults. strict: deny WITH a diagnostic naming the missing path — never a silent empty-allowlist lockout, never MONAI literals baked into core as a fallback.
seam.model_routing: Cursor honors model: frontmatter on agents/subagents only, not skills. Enforced only for the spec-critic agent; other stage tiers are a talk-track in v1.

core.summary: Library-agnostic engine + persona shells. Ships to an org/private Cursor plugin unchanged.

components.pack_config: Path allowlists (STRICT_PREFIXES / EVERYDAY_PREFIXES), deprecated-API patterns, and anti-pattern strings in policy.py / prompt_coach.py are library data, not core code. See seam.hook_facing_config: they move to the consumer's .cursor/pack.config.json, read via CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR — NOT resolved from the pack plugin.
components.extraction_note: Move scripts verbatim; replace the inlined constants with reads from $CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR/.cursor/pack.config.json. The pack owns the schema + example; the consumer owns the instance.

components.split: The orchestration shell (persona, steps, ledger append, output checklist) is core and stays LIBRARY-AGNOSTIC. MONAI specifics (transform paths, runtests.sh, changelog format) reach the agent via the pack's injected .mdc rules — NOT a body fragment spliced from the pack (Cursor has no cross-plugin path). See seam.agent_facing_content.
components.extraction_note: Core keeps a generic shell that says 'follow the active pack's injected rules'; the pack's rules carry the specifics. Full MONAI skills (/scaffold-*) ship whole in the pack.

components.split: The detect-drift-then-fail pattern is core; the checked file list + CONTRIBUTING excerpts are pack.
components.extraction_note: Core ships the runner; pack ships the manifest of files to guard.

schema.note: extra keys (persona, stage, skill, path, reason) are open; report aggregates per-persona / per-stage / decision; dashboard adds Layer C score HTML.

components.extraction_note: Schema + report/dashboard are library-agnostic; ship as-is.

components.split: The structure (boundary explanation, persona map, when-to-use rules/refs/@Docs) is core; the MONAI specifics are pack.
components.extraction_note: Core ships an AGENTS.md template; pack fills library sections.
strict|everyday toggle is core; the allowlist it selects comes from the consumer's .cursor/pack.config.json instance (seam.hook_facing_config).

pack.summary: MONAI content: intensity-transform contribution spine plus Phase 1 loss/metric/network archetype packs. One pack per target library; swap this folder to retarget the platform.

components.extraction_note: Phase 4: authoring SSOT moves to plugins/pack-monai/refs/; a materialized copy lands in the consumer's .cursor/refs/ and rules re-point from docs/cursor-kit/monai-refs/ to .cursor/refs/. See seam.refs. Read on demand, not injected.

components.note: The scanning pattern could be hoisted to core; the MONAI API/changelog specifics stay pack.
Seeded catalog (RobustScaleIntensity primary; AsinhIntensity / TanhSqueezeIntensity backups).
Deprecated np.float arg + missing __all__ registration, caught by check-deprecations.sh and /strengthen-tests.

components.extraction_note: Loss/metric/network packs are MONAI-specific; swap per target library. The scaffold-skill shells are core-shaped but their bodies reference MONAI neighbors, so they ship in the pack for v1.

roadmap.note: This manifest describes the CURRENT in-repo kit (skeleton). The design spec sequences the migration; nothing below is built until its Phase 2 seam spike passes.
roadmap.phase_1_kit_branch: Layer T (SPEC + failing tests) + spec-critic AGENT (model: HIGH) — no plugin work.
roadmap.phase_2_spike: Prove the seam (workspaceOpen load + hooks reading .cursor/pack.config.json via CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR + strict deny-with-diagnostic + zero MONAI literals in core).
roadmap.phase_3_5: Seam -> monorepo layout + thin consumer -> workspaceOpen auto-load + Layer D/E.

not_in_v1: Marketplace/plugin publish (build proof via local symlink; Team Marketplace = talk track)
Standing PERSONA agents (skills stay for explicit / stage control). NOTE: the spec-critic IS a v1 agent — only the broader persona-as-agent routing is deferred.
workspaceOpen pack auto-load (v1 = manual enable; auto-load is a post-spike upgrade)
